page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c28g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance belonging to the ecs.gn5 family. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this instance provides 56 dedicated physical CPU cores with one thread per core, ensuring consistent compute performance without resource sharing. The system is equipped with 224.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per CPU core.

The instance features hardware acceleration provided by two NVIDIA P100 GPUs, delivering a combined 32 GB of VRAM. For local data storage, the server is equipped with a 944 GB SSD. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps, facilitating steady data transfer rates for distributed workloads.

This hardware configuration is positioned for workloads requiring parallel processing capabilities, such as deep learning training, scientific computing, and video rendering. While the Pascal-architecture NVIDIA P100 GPUs represent an older hardware generation compared to newer accelerators, they offer a resource-dense option for legacy GPU-accelerated applications and general-purpose high-performance computing tasks.

This configuration is suitable for deep learning, high-performance computing, and video transcoding tasks that benefit from dedicated CPU resources and dual-GPU acceleration.
